review_response_tasks.stem: 学校正在用数字设备保存这批旧照片。（现在进行时的被动语态；preserve）
referenceAnswers: These old photographs are being preserved with digital equipment by the school.
These old photos are being preserved by the school using digital equipment.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 旧照片作承受者，are being preserved体现正在进行的被动；The school preserves虽然近义却不满足指定结构。

review_response_tasks.stem: 虽然腿受伤了，Nora依然完成了比赛，这使她的家人感到自豪。（定语从句；injure）
referenceAnswers: Although her leg was injured, Nora still finished the race, which made her family proud.
Although Nora had injured her leg, she still finished the race, which made her family proud.
review_response_tasks.rationale: injure的恰当形式与让步关系保留，which从句指完成比赛这件事；仅用and made改写没有满足定语从句要求。

review_response_tasks.stem: 许多初学者发现清楚地解释这个过程很有挑战性。（find＋宾语＋宾语补足语；challenge）
referenceAnswers: Many beginners find it challenging to explain this process clearly.
Many beginners find explaining this process clearly a challenge.
review_response_tasks.rationale: it＋形容词补语＋真正宾语，或动名词宾语＋名词补语均满足find结构；challenge可转challenging，不能find it is challenging冒充该宾补结构。

review_response_tasks.stem: 我仍记得那个下午，你的鼓励打消了我的疑虑。（定语从句；sweep）
referenceAnswers: I still remember the afternoon when your encouragement swept away my doubts.
I still remember that afternoon, when your encouragement swept my doubts away.
review_response_tasks.rationale: when引导修饰afternoon的定语从句，swept away表达打消疑虑；时点与鼓励行为相连，不能仅并列两句而漏规定结构。

review_response_tasks.stem: 老师们担心练习时间的减少可能影响学生的进步。（concern, loss）
referenceAnswers: Teachers are concerned that the loss of practice time may affect students' progress.
The teachers are concerned that a loss of practice time might affect the students' progress.
review_response_tasks.rationale: be concerned与loss都须保留，may/might表达可能性；绝对断言一定毁掉进步改变原意，lost不能代替规定的名词loss。
